whatIndependenceMeansHere: The pages were rasterised from the finished artifact bytes and looked at as images. This review is independent of the render report and of the field map: it can see a value clipped by its widget, a value in the wrong column, a caption overwritten, or a blank that should be empty carrying ink. It is NOT a substitute for the human independent visual review the production holds require, and it grants no approval.
verdict: No page shows a participant value in a blank that does not belong to it, no clipped value, and no signature, signature date, certificate-of-service or court-only rule carrying ink.
stillRequired: Output-level legal approval; this build only requests it.
